categories.main_business_segments: Shindaeyang Paper Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: corrugated paperboard base paper and corrugated boxes. The company produces and sells corrugated base paper including kraft liner, test liner, and corrugated medium, as well as corrugated box products. Its subsidiaries also engage in related manufacturing and sales activities within these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes capital-intensive manufacturing processes with large-scale production facilities, including long mesh corrugated medium production lines. It holds ISO 9002 quality certification and employs advanced production methods for kraft liner, test liner, and corrugated medium. The production process involves converting raw materials like domestic waste paper and pulp into corrugated base paper and boxes, with a focus on high-quality, multi-variety production to meet customer specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include corrugated box manufacturers and end-users across various industries such as fiber products, electronics, food, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying corrugated base paper to domestic corrugated box producers and exporting to foreign corrugated paper manufacturers. The corrugated box segment sells directly to end-users based on customer orders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities located in Ansan, Siwha, and other regions. It exports products internationally through agents and direct sales channels to foreign corrugated paper manufacturers. The company’s market presence is primarily domestic with growing export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shindaeyang Paper Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the corrugated packaging supply chain. It manufactures corrugated base paper (midstream) and corrugated boxes (downstream), supplying raw materials to box manufacturers and producing finished packaging products for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on maintaining high product quality and expanding market share through multi-variety, high-quality production. It emphasizes operational efficiency and cost reduction to improve profitability. There are no specific R&D activities reported, but the company invests in facility upgrades and capacity expansions to sustain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of corrugated base paper and corrugated boxes. Sales are conducted primarily on a made-to-order basis with direct transactions for domestic customers and exports through agents or direct export sales. Additional minor revenue streams include steam sales, waste synthetic material sales, and rental income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with approximately 14 major corrugated base paper producers in South Korea, including Asia Paper, Korea Export Packaging, and others. It holds a competitive position with significant production capacity and market share, accounting for over 8% of the domestic corrugated base paper market. The corrugated box segment faces competition from about 140 companies, with competition based on price, quality, delivery, and production flexibility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 645 billion KRW, with a slight decline compared to the previous year. Operating profit increased by 15%, reflecting improved cost management despite a 4.6% revenue decrease. Total assets stand at about 876 billion KRW, with stable equity and a low debt ratio of 27.6%, indicating a solid financial position. The company has experienced steady production capacity and market share in its core segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shindaeyang Paper emphasizes high-quality, multi-variety production tailored to customer specifications, ensuring timely delivery and competitive pricing. It differentiates itself through large-scale production capacity, quality certifications, and a comprehensive product range covering all types of corrugated base paper. The company’s integrated supply chain from base paper to finished boxes allows for quality control and responsiveness to market demands.
